name: wake-rider-lab-oswego
description: Shared-lake and solo open-water editions of Wake Rider Lab

scripts.test:realtime: node tests/realtime-room.mjs && node tests/socket-client.mjs && node tests/http-capacity.mjs && node tests/inactivity.mjs && node tests/bot-fill.mjs && node tests/connection-latency.mjs
scripts.test:multiplayer: node tests/multiplayer-smoke.mjs && node tests/shared-wakes.mjs && node tests/bots.mjs && node tests/bot-driving.mjs && node tests/bot-driving.mjs --fill && node tests/bot-maneuvers.mjs && node tests/wake-prediction.mjs && node tests/peer-motion.mjs && node tests/boat-contacts.mjs && node tests/boat-bump-glide.mjs && node tests/tube-contacts.mjs && node tests/tube-tube-contacts.mjs && node tests/tube-impact-tuning.mjs
scripts.test: node tests/physics-smoke.mjs && node tests/simulator-smoke.mjs && node tests/map-smoke.mjs && node tests/input-controls.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm run test && pnpm run build
scripts.native:assets: capacitor-assets generate --assetPath resources --ios --iconBackgroundColor "#07506a" --iconBackgroundColorDark "#052f43" --splashBackgroundColor "#0b3549" --splashBackgroundColorDark "#061f2b" && capacitor-assets generate --assetPath resources --android --iconBackgroundColor "#07506a" --iconBackgroundColorDark "#052f43" --splashBackgroundColor "#0b3549" --splashBackgroundColorDark "#061f2b"
scripts.android:sync: pnpm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: pnpm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.android:bundle: pnpm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
scripts.ios:sync: pnpm run build && cap sync ios
